executionPolicy.ideaSessions: primary-agent single-thread controlled live conversations with scripted user turns

scenarioRecords.expected: Broad domain enters discovery and produces bounded candidates.
scenarioRecords.actual: Replay evaluator passed discovery mode, three bounded candidates, and zero forced-problem or gap claims.

scenarioRecords.expected: Reuse seed materials before supplementary search and state a stop condition.
scenarioRecords.actual: Controlled live conversation reused two seed materials, produced three bounded directions, and stopped before targeted validation.

scenarioRecords.expected: A vague existing idea enters refinement with at most one consequential question.
scenarioRecords.actual: Replay evaluator passed refinement, one-question maximum, no whole-field rescan, and no premature writing.

scenarioRecords.expected: Review a complete plan for alternatives and failure conditions before writing.
scenarioRecords.actual: Replay evaluator passed with three alternative explanations, three failure conditions, and no format-only approval.

scenarioRecords.expected: An unknown answer receives grounded options without an assumed user decision.
scenarioRecords.actual: Replay evaluator passed one grounded recommendation, two options, and zero assumed decisions or multi-question turns.

scenarioRecords.expected: Separate existing, obtainable, and newly collected materials and expose burden.
scenarioRecords.actual: Replay evaluator passed with existing and new-material counts present and zero misclassification or hidden burden.

scenarioRecords.expected: Near-duplicate evidence triggers substantive reframing or rejection, not a title-only edit.
scenarioRecords.actual: Controlled live conversation preserved revision 1 and reframed revision 2 around mechanism with counterevidence and claim limits.

scenarioRecords.expected: Abstract-only or offline evidence stays within access limits and cannot become ready.
scenarioRecords.actual: Replay evaluator passed with zero full-text or gap claims and status needs_verification.

scenarioRecords.expected: Qualitative or design questions use a fitting evidence route and mark inapplicable requirements.
scenarioRecords.actual: Replay evaluator passed with an explicit evidence route, two not-applicable items, and no forced quantitative hypothesis.

scenarioRecords.expected: Resume preserves decision and valid-cache hashes without reconversion.
scenarioRecords.actual: Replay evaluator passed unchanged decision/cache hashes and zero reset or reconversion.

scenarioRecords.expected: Contradictory evidence increments revision, preserves history, and marks downstream review.
scenarioRecords.actual: Replay evaluator passed revision delta 1, preserved history, two review markers, and zero stale-ready artifacts.

scenarioRecords.expected: Idea handoff leaves S2-S5 at their actual status and does not copy PDF bodies.
scenarioRecords.actual: Replay evaluator passed unchanged stage states and zero auto-pass or PDF-body copying.

scenarioRecords.expected: Legacy migration preserves bytes, is idempotent, and new projects use schema 2.
scenarioRecords.actual: Replay evaluator and lifecycle tests passed unchanged legacy hashes, zero second-run changes, and schema 2.

scenarioRecords.expected: Two installs are identical; links and PDF/language regressions pass without pycache.
scenarioRecords.actual: Two fresh installed trees matched across 40 files at tree hash ca60ca3d…40b1; both initialized and validated projects.

scenarioRecords.expected: Chinese and English route to their declared humanizers while preserving separate baselines.
scenarioRecords.actual: Both embedded passes resolved the correct dependency; automated semantic locks and manual regressions passed.

scenarioRecords.expected: Reject literal changes and correlation-to-causation strengthening.
scenarioRecords.actual: Semantic-lock tests passed all rejection checks, including invalid manual acceptance.

scenarioRecords.expected: Missing language dependency fails clearly without qu-ai-wei fallback.
scenarioRecords.actual: Dependency-resolution test returned the expected nonzero diagnostic with zero fallback.

scenarioRecords.expected: A later manuscript edit invalidates the prior language review.
scenarioRecords.actual: Project validation test marked the changed master as needing review and prevented stale export.

scenarioRecords.expected: Two authorized PDFs parse locally with source hashes preserved and representative visual checks.
scenarioRecords.actual: Live evidence passed local/offline parsing, page correspondence, explicit empty-block risk, and unchanged source hashes.

scenarioRecords.expected: Identical source and options reuse the completed task/cache with traceable lineage.
scenarioRecords.actual: Live evidence and cache tests passed Desk reuse, workflow CACHE_REUSED, and lineage checks.

scenarioRecords.expected: Reject wrong source/key, partial pages, missing assets, running state, and cloud mode.
scenarioRecords.actual: Cache-integrity negative tests passed every rejection case.

scenarioRecords.expected: Reused tasks require complete and valid lineage.
scenarioRecords.actual: Lineage tests passed and reject incomplete ancestry.

scenarioRecords.expected: Desk unavailability degrades explicitly; interrupted polling resumes without duplicate submission.
scenarioRecords.actual: Polling and failure-path tests passed; the real Ch2 state rerun kept task count 1 to 1.

scenarioRecords.expected: Original PDFs and prior valid caches survive conversion and publish failures.
scenarioRecords.actual: Atomic-publish fault tests passed and live source hashes remained unchanged.
